business_summary: Toyo Shutter Co., Ltd. manufactures, installs, purchases, imports, sells, and exports various shutters, doors, hardware, building fixtures, materials, and consumables in Japan. The company offers heavy, lightweight, aluminum, madrimo, blinds, and high-speed sheet shutters; overdoor; hangar door; disaster prevention products, such as movable smoke barrier curtain and wall, non-combustible sheet smoke barrier wall, fire and smoke-proof screens, fireproof down panel, and emergency shutter opening and closing system; building materials; butter stopper; and holding gate, ETC wireless system, billfine, and other products. It also provides steel, front, and special doors; flooding prevention equipment, including watertight door and aluminum water barrier; residential overhead doors; locks, hardware, cylinder type, and cutout diagram products. In addition, the company offers architectural hardware, marine fixtures and decorative hardware, furniture, and kitchen equipment, as well as security equipment. Additionally, it engages in the design, supervision, contracting, and construction of buildings and facilities; design and construction of electrical equipment; development of computer software; sale of computer equipment; sale, installation, and repair of various electrical transport machines, electrical equipment, and materials; and selling, leasing, brokerage, and management of real estate. Further, the company is involved in outdoor advertising; maintenance work; acquisition, leasing, and sale of industrial property rights, copyrights and other intangible property rights, know-how, system engineering, and other software; non-life insurance agency business; automobile liability insurance agency business; and business related to solicitation of life insurance. Toyo Shutter Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
